items.title: Memory chip crunch could last 2 more years, JPMorgan says
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Senior Business Reporter Ines Ferre joins Opening Bid to discuss JPMorgan's (JPM) latest note, warning that the memory chip shortage could continue for at least two more years. Ferre also breaks down the S&P 500's (^GSPC) bullish run, which has produced 26 record closes in 2026.

items.title: Why Google and Amazon rank top among Cloud hyperscalers for AI
items.summary: Sevens Report Research founder Tom Essaye explains why cloud capacity is the next critical bottleneck in AI infrastructure and ranks Google (GOOG), Amazon (AMZN), and Microsoft (MSFT) based on their cloud revenue opportunities.

items.title: HPQ Pays You More Cash Than Most Of The Market
items.summary: The company behind your office computer is offering a cash yield that dwarfs the market average, but investors are hesitating. Here’s the math, the machine, and the reason for the discount.

items.title: Amazon Stock And The Profit Signal Everyone Is Chasing
items.summary: Management set a higher bar for profits, and the stock has already jumped, but the real story is how much faster the bottom line is guided to grow than the top line.

items.title: CRM Stock Has Bounced From This Price Before. Now What?
items.summary: Salesforce stock has fallen to a price floor that has launched powerful rallies before, forcing investors to decide if the company's booming AI business can overcome its current challenges.

items.title: Microsoft Stock Runs One Of The Market's Biggest Cash-Return Machines
